title: HACK THE HUB 2025
body:
HACK THE HUB

April 7th - April 21st, 2025

Join us for two weeks of rebuilding the commons hub, renewing its spirit and reimagining its future.

We invite all friends of the Hub to contribute with their skills, ideas, and energy to its physical, digital and conceptual improvement, and to celebrate its resurrection with three days of Easter festivities.

While we’re open to creative input, a few key projects involve:

  • Building bunk beds and other minor projects;

  • Painting a mural on the kitchen wall facing the garden;

  • Finishing construction works in and around the house;

  • Resetting veggie beds and expanding our garden capacity; 

  • Improving our digital infrastructure and exploring new functions;

  • Conceptualizing social protocols that foster stronger community ties;

  • Working with a shaman to cleanse the Hub of lingering negative energies.

 

Board and lodging are free, as we count on your help to get the Hub in shape. More than that, though, we seek your feedback on professionalizing the Hub while honoring the values of its surrounding community. Participation in this event will have a lasting impact, not just on the space itself, but also on its atmosphere and culture.

Let’s build, dream, and celebrate together—to a bright future for the Hub and its community!

title: BOULDER & BUILD
body:
Boulder & Build

A Climbing and Community Adventure

July 18th - July 27th, 2025


Join us for an immersive event combining the thrill of climbing with the joy of hands-on creation! Together, we'll construct a bouldering wall and training facility beneath the museum's "flugdach" (flying roof)—a striking architectural canopy—while diving into the rich climbing culture of the area.

What to Expect

  • Climbing Skill Sharing: Hone your skills and learn from fellow climbers in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Explore the Routes: With over 2,000 climbing routes in the region, from sport climbing to legendary multi-pitch challenges, there’s something for every level of climber.
  • Multi-Pitch Adventures: For those seeking a thrill, tackle breathtaking multi-pitch routes and experience the awe of climbing high above the valley.

A Typical Day

Morning: Hit the crags and climb to your heart’s content.
Afternoon: Cool down with a refreshing swim in the crystal-clear waters of the Schwarza River.
Evening: Join the team in building the bouldering wall and training area, adding your unique touch to this community project.
Night: Unwind at the sweat lodge and hot tub, sharing stories and laughter under the stars.
Whether you're a seasoned climber or just starting out, Boulder and Build offers the perfect mix of adventure, creativity, and camaraderie. Come be part of something extraordinary—exploring, building, and connecting in one of the most stunning climbing destinations in the world.

See you on the wall!

title: SOLARPUNK POW
summary: Harvesting Hope and Renewal at Solarpunk POW
body:
SOLARPUNK POW

A Celebration of Resilience and Renewal

OCTOBER 5th - OCTOBER 12th, 2025

This spring, the Commons Hub invites you to the SOLARPUNK POW, a vibrant gathering celebrating the possibilities of regenerative futures. In the spirit of Erntedankfest (Harvest Thanksgiving), we come together to honor the natural cycles of life, work the land, and cultivate both community and resilience.

What’s Happening?

  • Get the FarmBot Running: Help us finally bring the FarmBot to life, automating sustainable farming practices and showcasing the power of open-source technology.
  • Prepare Garden and Fields: Join hands as we sow and prepare the fields of the horse farm for the upcoming growing season.
  • Strengthen the Hub’s Resilience: Together, we’ll implement agricultural practices that enhance the Commons Hub’s self-sufficiency and showcase regenerative methods for thriving in a changing world.

More Than Farming

SOLARPUNK POW isn’t just about agriculture—it’s a celebration of a holistic vision for the future. Expect a lively mix of:

  • Workshops and Discussions: Delve into themes of regenerative technologies, solar energy, and community resilience.
  • Permaculture and DIY Projects: Learn from experts in hands-on sessions to take your sustainability skills to the next level.
  • Morning Meditations and Nature Baths: Reconnect with your surroundings and set the tone for a day of meaningful work and play.
  • Evening Fires and Dancing: Share laughter, stories, and music under the stars.

Whether you're an idealist, a tinkerer, or a dreamer of a brighter future, SOLARPUNK POW is the place to connect, create, and cultivate a thriving world.

Together, let’s sow the seeds of a regenerative tomorrow. Join us!

title: AI Agents Gathering
summary: Join us for an unforgettable journey into the world of AI agents
body:
AI Agents Gathering and Hacker House in the Austrian Alps  

Join us for an unforgettable journey into the world of AI agents at the Commons Hub, a charming events venue nestled in the stunning Austrian Alps. Over the course of one week, our AI Agents Gathering will bring together curious minds, innovators, and enthusiasts to explore the cutting-edge intersection of AI agents and Crypto. This immersive event fosters a unique environment for sharing knowledge, building connections, and sparking new ideas.

But we’re not stopping there. Following the gathering, we’ll host a 3-week Hacker House retreat, designed for deeper collaboration and creation. This extended program gives participants the time and space to form teams, connect with existing platforms and projects, and turn their ideas into viable, fundable ventures. With a balance of focused work and opportunities for decompression, the retreat is as much about creative productivity as it is about enjoying the serene beauty of the Alps.

The Commons Hub’s intimate atmosphere is ideal for fostering meaningful conversations, brainstorming sessions, and spontaneous collaborations. Attendees can enjoy hiking, outdoor adventures, and fun activities that help recharge and inspire. By blending work with exploration and relaxation, this event is designed to promote both personal and professional growth.

Whether you're an AI researcher, developer, crypto enthusiast, entrepreneur, or simply curious about the future of decentralized technologies and intelligent systems, this event is for you. Meet like-minded peers, gain insights from experts, and establish lasting connections that can help bring your visions to life.

Don’t miss this chance to combine learning, creation, and natural beauty in a truly unique setting. Together, let’s shape the future of AI agents and their potential to transform the world.

title: Collaborative Finance Gathering
summary: Mutual & mesh credit, local vouchers, multilateral offsets, and other elements of alternative finance.
body:
Collaborative Finance

16-20 June, 2025

CoFi 3 brings together attendees from previous CoFi events and welcomes many new participants for a week-long gathering at the Commons Hub. The event is designed to nurture both intellectual and social connections, with a dynamic schedule that includes structured sessions in the morning, unconference-style discussions in the afternoon, and evenings dedicated to relaxation and community building. Participants can look forward to activities in the surrounding natural area, including hiking and swimming, as well as opportunities to gather around the fire or unwind in the hot tub. This holistic format is intended to foster a balance between deep collaboration and personal rejuvenation.

Expanding on its collaborative ethos, CoFi 3 will delve into the intricacies of alternative financial systems, covering topics like mutual credit, mesh credit, local voucher systems, and multilateral offset clearing. The mornings will feature focused discussions and presentations, while the afternoons will allow for organic exploration through working groups. These sessions aim to create space for participants to address specific challenges, share insights, and advance ongoing projects. The inclusive and open vibe of CoFi ensures a welcoming atmosphere for diverse voices and perspectives, encouraging meaningful exchanges that transcend geographical and cultural boundaries.


Read more, join the Telegram and follow CoFi on Twitter!

title: CRYPTO COMMONS GATHERING 2025
body:
The fifth edition of the Crypto Commons Gathering will once more bring together hackers & builders, visionaries, artists, creatives and others with affiliation to the web3 ecosystem to imagine desired futures, probe regenerative forms of living, and playfully explore commons practices.

When: 24–30 August, 2025
Where: Commons Hub in Austria

We invite old and new friends of the Crypto Commons Movement to this special event – mark the dates and stay tuned for more information!
